description:
The `make pr-ready ... EVIDENCE=...` path arms auto-merge through scripts/pr_landing.py (Makefile:1220-1224, 1179-1195, 1041-1051; enqueue_pr at pr_landing.py:1293-1306 runs `gh pr merge --auto --squash --match-head-commit`). For a soundness PR it refuses twice: it requires APPROVED (pr_landing.py:1208-1209), which cannot happen because the develop ruleset requires 0 approvals and an author cannot approve their own PR, and it refuses outright (:1217-1218). `make pr-ready` without EVIDENCE routes to pr_arm.py, which defers to the required oracle-review check. arm_current_pr (:1783, soundness refusal at :1807) is reachable only from tests, because _run_arm raises (:1861-1862).

Make ready_failures defer to the required oracle-review check as pr_arm.py does, and remove the unreachable arm_current_pr soundness branch (or the function).
